title: Die Leere zwischen den Zeilen — a bitmap title and a live visitor count
note: An essay site about online connection and loneliness. The title "DIE LEERE ZWISCHEN DEN ZEILEN" is set in a stepped pixel face (custom "custom_170819", about 95px, 700) whose strokes break into small offset slabs, like a low-resolution LCD. Everything else is a small pixel mono ("cyty", 16px, -1px tracking) in #1E1D1D on white: HOME, an outlined pill button "WENN DU GERADE NICHT WEITERWEIẞT" (when you don't know what to do next), and "■ 24 PERSONEN AUCH HIER", a live count of people reading right now, with a green #2ECC71 dot. "Online connected / Offline" and "allein" float under the title. Worth reusing: a presence counter as content, not a feature, and a bitmap display face paired with a pixel mono.
